subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` be writable through the model-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` tool, or should they remain direct-config/doctor-only settings?
rationale: The fields are documented user config, but the current Gateway tool allowlist is an explicit model-to-operator trust boundary and prior fix PRs were closed without resolving that acceptance question.

options.title: Allow default bootstrap limits
options.body: Permit the two documented default-level bootstrap limit paths through the Gateway config mutation guard with focused tests and live restart/config-write proof.

options.title: Keep model-facing writes blocked
options.body: Leave the agent tool boundary unchanged and clarify that users must edit these limits through direct config or a non-model-controlled settings surface.

options.title: Design broader bootstrap settings
options.body: Review default and per-agent bootstrap limit writes together, including resource-limit validation and UI/docs expectations.

recommendation.title: Allow default bootstrap limits
recommendation.body: Permit the two documented default-level bootstrap limit paths through the Gateway config mutation guard with focused tests and live restart/config-write proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work changed the same protected Gateway config mutation boundary, making them the best routing candidate for the allowlist decision.
